out.title: Group Head Sanjay D'Souza retires from HDFC Bank
out.summary: Sanjay D'Souza, Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and Senior Management Personnel, superannuated effective October 31, 2026, after nearly 27 years; a key architect of the Bank's SME business.

person.name: Sanjay D'Souza
person.role: Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group
person.bio: Nearly 27 years at HDFC Bank; key architect of its SME business, contributing across Credit and Business, establishing leadership in the space.
